actors: Change people's org and project roles and turn actors on or off.
actors project-role: Give a person a role on one project, or take it away.
actors project-role remove: Remove a person's role on one project.
actors project-role set: Set a person's only role on one project.
actors role: Change or remove a person's org role.
actors role remove: Remove a person's org role; they keep only project roles.
actors role set: Set a person's org role: owner, admin, operator or viewer.
actors state: Turn an actor on or off.
actors state set: Enable or disable an actor and its keys.
